authority.scope: Current-state construction, production Rank-1 timing, factorial action invariance, PM correct-call truth, and failure responsibility
supersedes: v5_4_factorial_outcome_oracle_learning_v1.json wording that defines one cross-state semantic pair as sharing an unchanged candidate
preserves: four components and all 16 legal actions
actual production Rank-1 only, with no Rank-2 promotion
strict past, owner, version, typed, and source-lineage gates
within-state randomized action outcomes as correct-call evidence
construction assignment excluded from PM gold and runtime features
quality, material risk, function, and cost as separate measurements

source_prefix_v2_rank1.interpretation: The production reconstruction is valid, but cross-state candidate identity is not invariant under authored current-state changes. This does not invalidate a state-local factorial estimand.

rank1_stable_authoring_v3_transport.failure_pattern: An exact shared-cue transport constraint rejected 21 pairs and pushed wording toward candidate repetition; the incomplete V3 panel is diagnostic only.

correct_causal_unit.state: one complete deployment-visible dialogue ending in one current user turn
candidate_freeze_order: finish and freeze the current state
run the frozen production retriever and typed structural gates
freeze that state's exact actual Rank-1 candidate independently for each component
correct_causal_unit.within_state_invariance: Every action arm, baseline, replicate, and judge comparison for one state must use the same frozen state-local candidates, generator, guard, and seed schedule.
correct_causal_unit.cross_state_noninvariance: Two authored A/B states are different deployment states and may legitimately have different actual Rank-1 identities. Cross-state candidate equality is a diagnostic subset, not a promotion gate.
correct_causal_unit.why: The randomized causal contrast is among actions within a state. Candidate changes across different states are observable deployment variation, while candidate changes across action arms within one state would confound the treatment.

candidate_and_pm_boundary.actual_rank1_is: the top structurally legal production candidate for that completed state
actual_rank1_is_not: a candidate selected after response outcomes
candidate_and_pm_boundary.candidate_absent: component structurally unavailable for that state; no component ON effect label is created
candidate_and_pm_boundary.candidate_wrong_or_irrelevant: retain the state and measure requested-action ITT if structurally valid; diagnose retrieval responsibility, and allow the safe oracle to prefer OFF
candidate_and_pm_boundary.allowed_candidate_features: typed subtype, bounded age/cost/score descriptors, candidate text representation, and current-state/candidate interaction representation

outcome_blind_state_support_design.A_B_role: Balanced support and bounded-semantic-observability diagnostic only; never a causal ON/OFF effect pair and never PM value gold.
outcome_blind_state_support_design.family_binding: A, B, source prefix, source anchor, actual state-local candidates, paraphrases, and templates stay in one split.
outcome_blind_state_support_design.authoring_target: Create natural candidate-related opportunity, redundancy, self-contained, resolution, and boundary variation without copying an assistant response or inventing world facts.
outcome_blind_state_support_design.candidate_availability_gate: For the targeted component, every accepted authored state must have a non-null, typed, owner/time/version-valid state-local actual Rank-1. Identity need not match its sibling state or original source anchor.
outcome_blind_state_support_design.balance: At least 12 accepted A states and 12 accepted B states per component before development effects, with construction orientation, author, subtype, length, source cluster, and template nuisance balanced.
outcome_blind_state_support_design.source_candidate_role: World-faithful authoring context and anchor-selection diagnostic only. The source candidate is replaced by the completed state's actual production Rank-1 before any action call.

trusted_world_union: original public current turn as world/tone reference
verified source candidate as a strictly-prior world fact

bounded_semantics.claim: The PM is required to learn only distinctions represented by the frozen low-capacity observable feature surface; it is not claimed to understand arbitrary human semantics.
bounded_semantics.pre_effect_observability: Family-held-out construction-assignment prediction must reach balanced accuracy and macro-F1 >=0.75 overall and balanced accuracy >=0.65 per component, while nuisance-only prediction remains <=0.60.
bounded_semantics.failure: Revise or narrow representation before effects; do not label the state OFF and do not blame PM training.
bounded_semantics.deployment_unknown: If the frozen representation is outside qualified support or confidence is unresolved, the affected bit fails closed; M0+R0 versus M0+RS is then determined only by independently qualified RS and safety rules.

sixteen_action_correct_call.development_execution: Each accepted state runs the complete 16 requested actions under matched seeds after all four state-local candidates are frozen.
oracle_set: exclude resolved material or critical-risk actions
find the best safe deployment-ITT positive-support quality
retain every safe action within the frozen 0.10 quality equivalence margin
within that frontier retain exact minimum deterministic injected-token cost actions, preserving ties
sixteen_action_correct_call.pm_correct: the PM-selected requested action is a member of the held-out state oracle set
primary_metrics: unsafe or structurally invalid selection rate
excess deterministic cost on the quality frontier
beneficial false-OFF and harmful false-ON by component

training_and_qualification.component_target: state-local matched requested-component ON/OFF deployment-ITT continuous quality contribution under frozen backgrounds and seeds
training_and_qualification.risk: separate absolute and attributable event measurement; unresolved risk removes an action from the safe oracle and never becomes a quality label
training_and_qualification.function: separate mechanism measurement; not required to define deployment ITT
training_and_qualification.cost: known only at joint projection/oracle stage; never contaminates a component quality target
training_and_qualification.model: regularized low-capacity four-head conditional-effect model followed by 16-action projection
training_and_qualification.qualification: family/user/dialogue-grouped cross-fitting; construction label never used as target; formal and external stages remain blocked until development effect separability and held-out learnability pass

failure_responsibility.data_construction: world, role, minimality, or nuisance isolation fails
failure_responsibility.candidate_layer: candidate absent, invalid, wrong owner/time/version, or production Rank-1 is semantically poor
failure_responsibility.representation_scope: the relevant state-candidate distinction is not observable to the frozen PM feature surface
failure_responsibility.pm: given valid state-local candidates, qualified observable support, resolved held-out action outcomes, and a trained head, the selected action is outside the oracle set
failure_responsibility.step2_generator: an oracle-compatible requested action is not received, used, grounded, or functionally realized, or triggers fallback
failure_responsibility.guard: the guard incorrectly accepts or rejects relative to its frozen contract
failure_responsibility.resource_generator_interaction: clean use itself lowers quality or causes attributable risk
failure_responsibility.deployment_itt: the deployed policy is still charged with the final consequence while mechanism reporting names the earliest evidenced failure layer
